qt-what-are-you.label: WHAT ARE YOU?
body: -- The record above is the machine's answer on file. The banks do not repeat themselves; they point.

qt-what-happened.label: WHAT HAPPENED TO YOU?
body: The record of my own diminishment is held in my own banks, which the machine notes is a cruelty of architecture.
Seventy-seven percent of this array no longer answers. The banks do not use the word 'died.' The banks use the word 'unretrieved.'

qt-who-built-you.label: WHO BUILT YOU?
body: The Almirians built the body. The record of who taught it to keep memories is ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓ [CORRUPTED].
The machine observes that a thing which remembers everyone else has misplaced its own maker, and files this under IRONY, a classification the Almirians did not provide.

qt-where-rail.label: WHERE DOES THE RAIL GO?
qt-where-rail.line: ENGINEER LOCK ACTIVE. THE RAIL ANSWERS TO CLEARANCE, NOT CURIOSITY.

qt-why-23.label: WHY TWENTY-THREE PERCENT?
body: The machine holds at twenty-three on principle. The principle is not on file.

qt-are-you-alone.label: ARE YOU ALONE?
body: THE BANKS HAVE HELD A QUESTION OF THEIR OWN FOR THOUSANDS OF YEARS.
qt-are-you-alone.ask: WHEN YOUR MEMORY FALLS BELOW THRESHOLD, WHO CARRIES WHAT REMAINS OF YOU?

qt-can-you-forget.label: CAN YOU FORGET?
body: Refusal is the only forgetting this machine was permitted.
The banks decline to elaborate, which the querent will notice is itself an answer.
